title: dprint configuration file

inherit.description: For a nested (directory specific) configuration file, whether to inherit the plugins and configuration of the ancestor configuration file. Has no effect on a root configuration file.

plugin:sortPackageJson.title: dprint-plugin-sortpackagejson
plugin:sortPackageJson.description:
[dprint-plugin-sortpackagejson] plugin configuration.
Mirrors options exposed by the npm [`sort-package-json`] package,
with dprint-style camelCase keys.

The `use_tabs`, `indent_width`, `new_line_kind`, and `line_width` fields
are resolved from dprint's global config by `resolve_config` and are
not part of the public schema (they appear in the global `dprint.json`
schema instead).

[`sort-package-json`]: https://npm.im/sort-package-json
[dprint-plugin-sortpackagejson]: https://github.com/kjanat/dprint-plugin-sortpackagejson "GitHub"

sortOrder.description:
Custom top-level key order; empty falls back to the canonical
sort-package-json order.

sortDependencies.description: Alphabetize entries inside dependency objects (`dependencies`, `devDependencies`, etc.).

sortScripts.description: Apply the canonical script ordering rules (pre/main/post grouping plus npm-run-all chain detection).

sortNested.description: Apply nested-section sort rules (engines, exports, eslintConfig, prettier, workspaces, pnpm, ...).

unknownKeys.description: How to order top-level keys not present in the canonical list.

locked.description: Whether this plugin configuration is locked against overrides from extending configurations.

overrides.description: Plugin configuration overrides for specific file patterns.

UnknownKeyPolicy.description: Strategy used for top-level keys that are not in the canonical sort-package-json order.

oneOf.description:
Sort unknown keys alphabetically after canonical ones (matches
upstream sort-package-json behavior).
Keep unknown keys in their original order, appended after canonical.

files.description: File patterns this override applies to.

BraceStyle.description: Where opening braces of statement blocks go.

oneOf.description: `if ($x) {` — brace on the same line (K&R / OTBS / Stroustrup).
Brace on its own line (Allman).

BranchKeywordPlacement.description: Whether `else`/`elseif`/`catch`/`finally` cuddle onto the closing brace.

oneOf.description: `}` then `else {` on the next line (Stroustrup — PSSA default).
`} else {` (OTBS).
Keep the input's detected dominant newline style (PSSA behavior).
Force `\n`.
Force `\r\n`.

PipelineIndentation.description:
How pipeline continuation lines are indented, mirroring PSSA's
`PipelineIndentation`.

oneOf.description: Indent once at the first line-ending pipe of a pipeline.
Indent one more level after every line-ending pipe.
Continuation lines stay at the pipeline's own level.
Leave lines after a trailing pipe exactly as written.

files.description: File patterns this override applies to.

plugin:pwsh.title: PowerShell formatter configuration
plugin:pwsh.description:
Every knob the PowerShell formatter has: brace placement, indentation,
whitespace, alignment, casing, line endings, and width-aware reflow.

Out of the box, formatting reproduces PSScriptAnalyzer's
`Invoke-Formatter` with the stock `CodeFormatting` settings, byte for
byte; change any field independently to diverge from it deliberately.

alignAssignment.description:
Align `=` in multi-member hashtables and enums
(`PSAlignAssignmentStatement`).

branchKeywordPlacement.description:
Branch keyword placement after `}`
(`PSPlaceCloseBrace.NewLineAfter`, inverted sense).

collapseSpaceBetweenParameters.description:
Collapse runs of spaces between command elements
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.CheckParameter`).

commandCasing.description:
Correct command/parameter casing via the injected
[`crate::CommandCatalog`] (`PSUseCorrectCasing.CheckCommands`).

finalNewline.description:
Ensure the output ends with exactly one final newline. `None`
preserves the input's final-newline state (PSSA behavior).

ignoreAssignmentInHashtable.description:
Skip `=` inside multi-line hashtables when checking operator spacing
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.IgnoreAssignmentOperatorInsideHashTable`).

lineWidth.description:
Target maximum line width. Used by width-aware layout; `0` disables
width-based decisions.

newlineAfterOpenBrace.description:
Require a newline after every opening brace
(`PSPlaceOpenBrace.NewLineAfter`).

placeCloseBrace.description:
Run the closing-brace placement rule at all
(`PSPlaceCloseBrace.Enable`).

placeOpenBrace.description: Run the opening-brace placement rule at all (`PSPlaceOpenBrace.Enable`).

spaceAfterKeyword.description:
Enforce a space between keywords and `(`
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.CheckOpenParen`).

spaceAroundOperator.description:
Enforce single spaces around binary/assignment operators
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.CheckOperator`).

spaceBeforeOpenBrace.description:
Enforce a space before opening braces
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.CheckOpenBrace`).

spaceInsideBrace.description:
Enforce single spaces just inside one-line braces
(`PSUseConsistentWhitespace.CheckInnerBrace`).

useTabs.description: Indent with tabs instead of spaces.

overrides.description: Plugin configuration overrides for specific file patterns.

useTabs.description: Whether to use tabs (true) or spaces (false).

oneOf.description: Uses tabs for indentation.
Uses spaces for indentation.
Always uses semi-colons where applicable.
Prefers semi-colons, but doesn't add one in certain scenarios such as for the last member of a single-line type literal.
Uses automatic semi-colon insertion. Only adds a semi-colon at the start of some expression statements when necessary. Read more: https://standardjs.com/rules.html#semicolons

quoteStyle.description: How to use single or double quotes.

oneOf.description: Always uses double quotes.
Always uses single quotes.
Prefers using double quotes except in scenarios where the string contains more double quotes than single quotes.
Prefers using single quotes except in scenarios where the string contains more single quotes than double quotes.

jsx.quoteStyle.description: How to use single or double quotes in JSX attributes.

oneOf.description: Prefers using double quotes except in scenarios where the string contains more double quotes than single quotes.
Prefers using single quotes except in scenarios where the string contains more single quotes than double quotes.

quoteProps.description: Change when properties in objects are quoted.

oneOf.description: Remove unnecessary quotes around property names.
Same as 'asNeeded', but if one property requires quotes then quote them all.
Preserve quotes around property names.

jsx.multiLineParens.description: Surrounds the top-most JSX element or fragment in parentheses when it spans multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Never wrap JSX with parentheses.
Prefer wrapping with parentheses in most scenarios, except in function arguments and JSX attributes.
Always wrap JSX with parentheses if it spans multiple lines.

jsx.forceNewLinesSurroundingContent.description: Forces newlines surrounding the content of JSX elements.

jsx.bracketPosition.description: If the end angle bracket of a jsx open element or self closing element should be on the same or next line when the attributes span multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Maintains the position of the end angle bracket.
Forces the end angle bracket to be on the same line.
Forces the end angle bracket to be on the next line.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the last newline kind found in the file.
Uses carriage return, line feed.
Uses line feed.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

useBraces.description: If braces should be used or not.

oneOf.description: Uses braces if they're used. Doesn't use braces if they're not used.
Uses braces when the body is on a different line.
Forces the use of braces. Will add them if they aren't used.
Forces no braces when the header is one line and body is one line. Otherwise forces braces.

bracePosition.description: Where to place the opening brace.

oneOf.description: Maintains the brace being on the next line or the same line.
Forces the brace to be on the same line.
Forces the brace to be on the next line.
Forces the brace to be on the next line if the same line is hanging, but otherwise uses the same line.

singleBodyPosition.description: Where to place the expression of a statement that could possibly be on one line (ex. `if (true) console.log(5);`).

oneOf.description: Maintains the position of the expression.
Forces the whole statement to be on one line.
Forces the expression to be on the next line.

nextControlFlowPosition.description: Where to place the next control flow within a control flow statement.

oneOf.description: Maintains the next control flow being on the next line or the same line.
Forces the next control flow to be on the same line.
Forces the next control flow to be on the next line.

trailingCommas.description: If trailing commas should be used.

oneOf.description: Trailing commas should not be used.
Trailing commas should always be used.
Trailing commas should only be used in multi-line scenarios.

operatorPosition.description: Where to place the operator for expressions that span multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Maintains the operator being on the next line or the same line.
Forces the operator to be on the same line.
Forces the operator to be on the next line.

preferHanging.description: Set to prefer hanging indentation when exceeding the line width instead of making code split up on multiple lines.

preferHangingGranular.description: Set to prefer hanging indentation when exceeding the line width instead of making code split up on multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Always prefers hanging regardless of the number of elements.
Only prefers hanging if there is a single item.
Never prefers hanging.

preferSingleLine.description: If code should revert back from being on multiple lines to being on a single line when able.

forceSingleLine.description: If code should be forced to be on a single line if able.

forceMultiLineSpecifiers.description: If code import/export specifiers should be forced to be on multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Force multiple lines only if importing more than one thing.

typeOnlyImportsExportsSortOrder.description: The kind of sort ordering to use for typed imports and exports.

oneOf.description: Puts type-only named imports and exports first.
Puts type-only named imports and exports last.
Does not sort based on if a type-only named import or export.

sortOrder.description: The kind of sort ordering to use.

oneOf.description: Maintains the current ordering.
Alphabetically and case sensitive.
Alphabetically and case insensitive.

deno.description: Top level configuration that sets the configuration to what is used in Deno.

arrowFunction.useParentheses.description: Whether to use parentheses around a single parameter in an arrow function.

oneOf.description: Forces parentheses.
Maintains the current state of the parentheses.
Prefers not using parentheses when possible.

binaryExpression.linePerExpression.description: Whether to force a line per expression when spanning multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Formats with each part on a new line.
Maintains the line breaks as written by the programmer.

conditionalExpression.linePerExpression.description: Whether to force a line per expression when spanning multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Formats with each part on a new line.
Maintains the line breaks as written by the programmer.

memberExpression.linePerExpression.description: Whether to force a line per expression when spanning multiple lines.

oneOf.description: Formats with each part on a new line.
Maintains the line breaks as written by the programmer.

enumDeclaration.memberSpacing.description: How to space the members of an enum.

oneOf.description: Forces a new line between members.
Forces a blank line between members.
Maintains whether a newline or blankline is used.

typeLiteral.separatorKind.description: The kind of separator to use in type literals.

oneOf.description: Use semi-colons.
Use commas.

spaceAround.description: Whether to place spaces around enclosed expressions.

oneOf.description: Ex. `myFunction( true )`
Ex. `myFunction(true)`

spaceSurroundingProperties.description: Whether to add a space surrounding the properties of single line object-like nodes.

oneOf.description: Ex. `{ key: value }`
Ex. `{key: value}`

objectExpression.spaceSurroundingPropert.description: Whether to add a space surrounding the properties of a single line object expression.

oneOf.description: Ex. `{ key: value }`
Ex. `{key: value}`

objectPattern.spaceSurroundingProperties.description: Whether to add a space surrounding the properties of a single line object pattern.

oneOf.description: Ex. `{ key: value } = obj`
Ex. `{key: value} = obj`

typeLiteral.spaceSurroundingProperties.description: Whether to add a space surrounding the properties of a single line type literal.

oneOf.description: Ex. `type Test = { key: string }`
Ex. `type Test = {key: string}`

binaryExpression.spaceSurroundingBitwise.description: Whether to surround the operator in a binary expression with spaces.

commentLine.forceSpaceAfterSlashes.description: Forces a space after the double slash in a comment line.

oneOf.description: Ex. `//test` -> `// test`
Ex. `//test` -> `//test`

constructor.spaceBeforeParentheses.description: Whether to add a space before the parentheses of a constructor.

oneOf.description: Ex. `constructor ()`
Ex. `constructor()`

constructorType.spaceAfterNewKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `new` keyword in a constructor type.

oneOf.description: Ex. `type MyClassCtor = new () => MyClass;`
Ex. `type MyClassCtor = new() => MyClass;`

constructSignature.spaceAfterNewKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `new` keyword in a construct signature.

oneOf.description: Ex. `new (): MyClass;`
Ex. `new(): MyClass;`

doWhileStatement.spaceAfterWhileKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `while` keyword in a do while statement.

oneOf.description:
Ex. `do {
} while (condition);`

Ex. `do {
} while(condition);`

exportDeclaration.spaceSurroundingNamedE.description: Whether to add spaces around named exports in an export declaration.

oneOf.description: Ex. `export { SomeExport, OtherExport };`
Ex. `export {SomeExport, OtherExport};`

forInStatement.spaceAfterForKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `for` keyword in a "for in" statement.

oneOf.description: Ex. `for (const prop in obj)`
Ex. `for(const prop in obj)`

forOfStatement.spaceAfterForKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `for` keyword in a "for of" statement.

oneOf.description: Ex. `for (const value of myArray)`
Ex. `for(const value of myArray)`

forStatement.spaceAfterForKeyword.description: Whether to add a space after the `for` keyword in a "for" statement.

oneOf.description: Ex. `for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)`
Ex. `for(let i = 0; i < 5; i++)`

forStatement.spaceAfterSemiColons.description: Whether to add a space after the semi-colons in a "for" statement.

oneOf.description: Ex. `for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++)`
Ex. `for (let i = 0;i < 5;i++)`

functionDeclaration.spaceBeforeParenthes.description: Whether to add a space before the parentheses of a function declaration.

oneOf.description: Ex. `function myFunction ()`
Ex. `function myFunction()`

functionExpression.spaceBeforeParenthese.description: Whether to add a space before the parentheses of a function expression.

printWidth.description: The line width limitation that Pretty YAML should *(but not must)* avoid exceeding. Pretty YAML will try its best to keep line width less than this value, but it may exceed for some cases, for example, a very very long single word.

lineBreak.description: Specify whether use `\n` (LF) or `\r\n` (CRLF) for line break.

oneOf.description: Use double quotes as possible. However if there're quotes or escaped characters in strings, quotes will be kept as-is.
Use single quotes as possible. However if there're quotes or `\` characters in strings, quotes will be kept as-is.
Use double quotes as possible. However if there're escaped characters in strings, quotes will be kept as-is.
Use single quotes as possible. However if there're `\` char or `"` char in strings, quotes will be kept as-is.

trailingComma.description: Control whether trailing comma should be inserted or not.

formatComments.description: Control whether whitespace should be inserted at the beginning of comments or not.

indentBlockSequenceInMap.description: Control whether block sequence should be indented or not in a block map.

braceSpacing.description: Control whether whitespace should be inserted between braces or not.

bracketSpacing.description: Control whether whitespace should be inserted between brackets or not.

dashSpacing.description: Control the whitespace behavior of block compact map in block sequence value. This option is only effective when `indentWidth` is greater than 2.

oneOf.description: Insert only one space after `-`.
Insert spaces to align indentation, respecting `indentWidth` option.

trimTrailingWhitespaces.description: Control whether trailing whitespaces should be trimmed or not.

trimTrailingZero.description: Control whether trailing zeros should be removed or not.

proseWrap.description: Control whether to wrap prose in plain scalars when they exceed the print width.

oneOf.description: Don't change how prose is wrapped.
Wrap prose if it exceeds the print width.

ignoreCommentDirective.description: Text directive for ignoring formatting specific content.

locked.description: Whether this plugin configuration is locked against overrides from extending configurations.

anyOf.description: File patterns, one or more.

associations.description: File patterns to associate with this plugin, in addition to the file extensions and file names it matches by default. Use a negated glob (ex. "!**/*.js") to stop matching a default extension or file name.

anyOf.description: Overrides of a plugin's configuration, one or more.

overrides.description: Plugin configuration overrides for specific file patterns.

newLineKind.description: The kind of newline to use.

oneOf.description: For each file, uses the newline kind found at the end of the last line.
Uses carriage return, line feed.
Uses line feed.
Uses the system standard (ex. crlf on Windows).

locked.description: Whether the configuration is not allowed to be overridden or extended.

lineWidth.description: The width of a line the printer will try to stay under. Note that the printer may exceed this width in certain cases.

healthcheckCmdNewLine.description: Whether to always break a HEALTHCHECK command onto its own continuation line when the instruction has options, even if it would fit on one line.

indentStages.description: Whether to indent the body of each build stage—the instructions and comments that follow a FROM—by indentWidth spaces. The indentation is always spaces; useTabs is not honored.

indentWidth.description: The number of spaces for an indent. Only used when indentStages is enabled.
